name: Cboe Global Markets
description: Cboe operates options exchanges (including index options and futures that it has the exclusive right to list and trade per its 10-K), U.S. and European cash equity exchanges, a futures exchange and an FX trading platform, and sells market data. Revenue was $4.7 billion in 2025 but $2.3 billion of that is cost of revenues (mostly liquidity payments and routing on equities), leaving $2.4 billion; options produced 52 percent of revenue and 75 percent of segment operating income. Fees are charged per contract or per share traded, so volatility and volume drive results. Data sales (Data Vantage) were $636 million.

businessLines.name: Options
businessLines.how: Per-contract fees on options traded on options traded on its U.S. options exchanges, including index options and futures it lists exclusively, plus market data and access fees; cost of revenues is liquidity and clearing costs (902.5).

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), revenues (gross of cost of revenues)

businessLines.name: North American Equities
businessLines.how: Per-share fees on U.S. and Canadian cash equity trading, largely offset by liquidity rebates and routing costs (cost of revenues 1,265.1), so little of each revenue dollar is kept.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), revenues (gross of cost of revenues)

businessLines.name: Europe and Asia Pacific
businessLines.how: Per-share fees on pan-European and Australian cash equity venues plus data.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), revenues (gross of cost of revenues)

businessLines.name: Futures
businessLines.how: Per-contract fees on futures traded on Cboe Futures Exchange.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), revenues (gross of cost of revenues)

businessLines.name: Global FX
businessLines.how: Trading fees on institutional FX, non-deliverable forwards and U.S. government securities platforms, plus data and access fees.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), revenues (gross of cost of revenues)

brands.name: Cboe Options exchanges
brands.note: Options segment: 51.6 percent of revenue, 75.5 percent of segment operating income (computed)

brands.name: Cboe Australia and Cboe Canada
brands.note: Being sold to TMX Group for about $300 million

whatsNext.text: Sell Cboe Australia and Cboe Canada to TMX Group for about $300 million; agreement announced 2026-04-22; Cboe Australia expected to close in Q3 2026, Canada after regulatory approval
Strategic realignment announced 2026-05-01 (resource reallocation across the organisation), expected substantially complete by end of 2026

profileAgainst: 10-K FY2025 (filed 2026-02-20); 10-Q Q2 2026 (filed 2026-07-31, read for divestiture and realignment)
